value.answer: It mostly depends on your down payment. If you're putting down under 20%, the lowest 5-year fixed I can see is about 4.34% (Ratehub, Oct 12). If you're putting down 20% or more, the lowest is about 4.44% (WOWA, Oct 9). The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%, and rates have been creeping up this month. Exact rates still depend on the lender.
